# Boot profile "generic": no CPU isolation.
# The base profile of every image: what QEMU boots, what the installation
# medium boots, and the safe fallback on real hardware (document 0, C-03).

# Serial console, after the screen so that it becomes /dev/console: QEMU
# tests read the boot from it, and on a real machine it is the way to
# read a kernel panic. A real serial port is slow and raises interrupts,
# so the profiles of real machines leave it out.
console=ttyS0,115200n8

# Tells dawos-tune and the boot report which profile was started.
dawos.profile=generic
